definitions.explanation: The company or person who receives a contract directly from the client and takes primary responsibility for a project. May subcontract portions of the work to other companies.

examples.japanese: {元請|もとう}け{会社|がいしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧。
{元請|もとう}け⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{下請|したう}け→下請け：10898_shitauke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}される→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
examples.english: Work is passed from the main contractor to the subcontractor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦ゼネコン→ゼネコン：11031_zenekon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{元請|もとう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めている→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: A major general contractor is serving as the prime contractor for this construction project.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (origin, source) and {請|う}け (receiving, contracting). Refers to the company at the top of the contracting chain that receives work directly from the client. Central to understanding Japanese business structure, especially in construction and IT.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {元請|もとう}け{会社|がいしゃ}: main contracting company
- {元請|もとう}け⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: prime contractor
- {元請|もとう}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as the main contractor
- {元請|もとう}け⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧: main contractor's responsibility

CONTRACTING HIERARCHY:
Japanese business often involves multi-layered contracting:
- {元請|もとう}け: main contractor (receives from client)
- ⟦{下請|したう}け→下請け：10898_shitauke⟧: subcontractor (receives from main contractor)
- {孫請|まごう}け: sub-subcontractor (receives from subcontractor)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{下請|したう}け→下請け：10898_shitauke⟧: subcontractor — receives work from the {元請|もとう}け
- {発注者|はっちゅうしゃ}: client, orderer — the party who hires the {元請|もとう}け
- ⟦ゼネコン→ゼネコン：11031_zenekon⟧: general contractor — large construction company that often acts as {元請|もとう}け
